name: HubSpot CRM
description: Search, read, and manage HubSpot CRM contacts, companies, deals, and tickets.
long_description: Connect Row-Bot to your HubSpot CRM. Read side: search contacts, companies, deals, and tickets, look up a single record by id, and summarize the open deal pipeline by stage. Write side: create, update, and delete records and log notes or tasks. All write actions are approval-gated through Row-Bot, so the agent asks for confirmation before changing anything in HubSpot. Authenticates with a HubSpot Private App access token.

default_count.label: Default number of results
default_count.description: How many records to return per search or list (1-30).

access_token.label: HubSpot Private App Token
access_token.description: Access token from a HubSpot Private App with CRM read scopes. Starts with 'pat-'.
